entries.zh: 礼：礼仪、礼制；此条以「礼」释西语 gobierno político「文治、礼治之政」，谓礼为文治之本
entries.en: propriety, rites, ritual decorum; given here as the equivalent of Sp. gobierno político 'civil governance, government by rites'

entries.zh: 洋：海洋、大海；对译 golfo（17 世纪义兼指海湾、深海），M 栏兼录又音 yõ
entries.en: ocean, open sea; rendering Sp. golfo 'gulf, deep sea'; the manuscript also records a second reading (yõ)

entries.zh: 打：击打、捶打（golpear；标注 Aux. 疑指其兼作助动词）；M 栏尾部残损
entries.en: to hit, strike, beat (golpear; the mark 'Aux.' likely notes an auxiliary-verb use); tail of the Hokkien line is damaged
entries.notes: M 栏标 [残] 且带 T99 污损记号，尾部「8a」无法确读；「打＝hit」之义由 L/H 两栏互证，故给释义而降为低置信。

entries.zh: 捺（原稿有 [疑:捺/捏] 之辨）：以指按压、捏捻；西语释文 golpear como el Zlaba 中「Zlaba」一词未能确解
entries.en: to press or pinch with the fingers (character uncertain: 捺/捏); the word 'Zlaba' in the Spanish gloss 'golpear como el Zlaba' is unidentified
entries.notes: 汉字栏有 [疑] 标注；「Zlaba」疑为手稿连写或转写讹误，无法确解，释义以 H/M 栏按压、捏捻之义为主。

entries.zh: 拂：掸拂、轻拂，即轻击之义（golpear）；括注 Thūi. 为原稿音注（互见），非另立字头
entries.en: to whisk, brush off, flick; a light stroke (golpear); the parenthetical Thūi. is an interlinear reading note, not a separate headword

entries.zh: 敲：敲门（呼人赴会、召人聚集之义，golpear llamando vno al ayunto）；M 栏第二音节 muỹ 之字未见于汉字栏
entries.en: to knock (at the door) to call someone to a gathering or meeting (ayunto); the second Hokkien syllable (recorded as muỹ) has no corresponding character
entries.notes: H 栏仅录「敲」，第二音节依「敲门召人」语境推断为「門」，未敢坐实。

entries.zh: 拍：拍打；此条谓以手中之扇拍击（golpear con el abanico en la mano）
entries.en: to pat, slap; here: to strike with the fan in one's hand
entries.notes: M 栏音写「pa」标 [残] 且带 T99 污损记号，其后内容缺损；「拍＝pat」之义由 L/H 栏互证。

entries.zh: 捶：捶击、捶打（golpear en los pechos，捶胸之义）；M 栏第二音节 húy 之字未见于汉字栏
entries.en: to pound, thump (golpear en los pechos = beat the breast); the second Hokkien syllable (recorded as húy) has no corresponding character
entries.notes: 首音节与「捶」互证清晰；第二音节之字未详（读音近「揮/晖」一系），不作坐实。

entries.zh: 击（原稿作「擊」）：击打、重击；连击、棒击之义（golpear, dar porrazos）
entries.en: to strike, hit; to deal blows (porrazos, cudgel blows)

entries.zh: 却（原稿有 [疑:卻/却] 之辨，两形实为同字异体）：本义退却、推却；此处当系借音作敲击拟声之用（参本页第 18、19 条「却却响」「却却扣」）
entries.en: què 却 (manuscript uncertain between graphic variants 卻/却): literally 'to retreat, decline'; here apparently a sound-loan used for the knock onomatopoe (cf. 却却响, 却却扣 on this page)
entries.notes: 汉字栏有 [疑] 标注；「却」与击打义之关联系音借推断，据同页 18/19 条拟声用法。

entries.zh: 叩：叩击作声（golpear haciendo ruido）；M 栏第二音节 cuĩ 之字未见于汉字栏
entries.en: to knock with a noise (golpear haciendo ruido); the second Hokkien syllable (recorded as cuĩ) has no corresponding character
entries.notes: 首音节与「叩」互证清晰；第二音节之字未详，或为拟声连读，不作坐实。

entries.zh: 打着：打着、打中（「打＋着」完成式构式）；M 栏重书两遍，示连续抽打之义（azotar 鞭笞）
entries.en: to hit and land a blow (compound 打+着 'strike-on'); written twice in the manuscript, glossing azotar 'to whip, flog'

entries.zh: 叩着：叩击而中、敲打一下（「叩＋着」构式）；同释 golpear, azotar（连打、鞭打）
entries.en: to knock and land a blow (compound 叩+着); glossing golpear/azotar 'to beat, flog'

entries.zh: 掷着（原稿作「擲着」）：掷而击中（「掷＋着」构式）；M 栏音写与「擲」字读音不合，且行内混入西语 azotar 字样
entries.en: to throw and strike (compound 擲+着); the recorded Hokkien line does not match the character's reading and even embeds the Spanish word azotar
entries.notes: M 栏首音节与「擲」读音不合、行内并混入西语原文，录文可疑；释义以 L/H 栏「掷而击中」为准。

entries.zh: 扣：叩击（此条谓叩击破瓮、破器）；第二字原稿有 [疑:國/囯] 之辨，且其音写与两形皆不合
entries.en: to knock, strike (here: to strike a broken vessel or jar, basija quebrada); the second character is doubtful (國/囯) and its recorded reading matches neither form
entries.notes: 第二字 [疑:國/囯] 两形音写均应为 kok 类而实录为 ham 类音，疑原字为「函/含」类 ham 音字之误读；释义以 L 栏「叩击破器」与首字「扣」为准。

entries.zh: 梢了（原稿有 [疑:梢/捎] 之辨）：「了」为完成语助词；首字之义与西语「叩击破器」无法确解对应
entries.en: a 'X + le' pattern with the first character uncertain (梢/捎) and 了 as completive particle; its link to Sp. 'strike the broken vessel' cannot be settled
entries.notes: 字有 [疑:梢/捎]，音写 sau 类与「叩击」义无法对应（或为「掃了/消了」类语词之借写），语义无法定夺，降为低置信。

entries.zh: 扣遮风（原稿作「扣遮風」）：遮风、挡风（遮挡风力，使风不得扑面）；西语释文有误读痕迹，谓风之扑击如尘旋
entries.en: to block the wind, shelter from wind (扣遮風); the Spanish gloss is garbled and appears to describe wind striking like a dust-whirl (cliento ≈ viento, echizo ≈ hechizo 'small whirlwind')
entries.notes: 西语 cliento 当为 viento、echizo 或即 hechizo（尘旋）之误读；汉侧「遮風」为挡风之义，两栏对应依赖推断。

entries.zh: 却却响：敲击拟声词，连击两声而作响（物被击而鸣响）；西语释文谓击之而破
entries.en: onomatopoeic knock: a double blow sounding out ('却却' + 响 'to ring'); the Spanish gloss describes striking as the thing breaks

entries.zh: 却却扣：敲门之声，连击两声复叩之（拟声＋动词「扣」）；即敲门（golpear la puerta）
entries.en: knocking on the door: an onomatopoeic double blow ('却却') followed by 扣 'to knock'
